newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedbank bids for parts of Stadshypotek - paper.
newsitem.headline: Swedbank bids for parts of Stadshypotek - paper.

text.p: Swedish banking group Swedbank has told the Swedish government it is interested in buying parts of mortgage institute Stadshypotek, Swedish financial daily Dagens Industri said on Monday.
"As we have said previously, we are interested in some bond stocks," Swedbank chairman Goran Collert was quoted as saying.
"Regarding this issue, you do not express interest to the finance ministry, but directly to Merrill Lynch. We have done this," he told the newspaper.
The government is selling its 34 percent stake in Stadshypotek through a controlled auction led by Merrill Lynch and interested players placed bids last Monday.
